target_claim: Indeed, let $m\neq n \in N(x)$. If we had $f_{x,y}(n) = f_{x,y}(m)$, then $N(n)\cap N(m)$ would have at least two distinct elements, namely $x$ and $f_{x,y}(n)$, a contradiction to our hypothesis!
